prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a practical 2D parkour character animation SPRITE SHEET, matching the reference character silhouette proportions. The supplied images are STYLE / CHARACTER PROPORTION REFERENCES ONLY. Make new poses for the requested mechanic. NOT a reference-game extraction.
Exactly EIGHT full-body silhouettes in a strict FOUR-COLUMN by TWO-ROW equal-cell grid, row-major reading order. Canvas landscape 2:1, ideally 1536x768 (each cell square). Each cell contains ONE separate complete pose only, at the same character scale. Maintain one consistent slim-athletic adult male silhouette: compact short-haired head, plain short-sleeve shirt, slim long trousers, simple shoes, rounded limb shapes, no face or interior detail, no accessory design. Solid pure BLACK silhouette with crisp clean anti-aliased edges on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. Maintain side-on orthographic camera, facing right throughout, no perspective, no front/back views. Whole body entirely within its cell with generous clear transparent gutters. Anatomically correct exactly two arms and two legs, no ghost limbs, no motion trails.
ALIGNMENT: each cell uses the same character pelvis/root position centered at 50% cell width and 53% cell height; keep consistent head/body proportions and no arbitrary zoom. Depict articulation through pose while world translation belongs to the game. Poses should show readable progression, strong gesture, separated limbs where physically plausible.
Never draw checkerboard, panels, cell borders, labels, digits, text, UI, logos, floor, background, shadows, gradients, glow, equipment, cable or rope. ONLY the character's body. Attachment cable/anchor/pad will be drawn separately by gameplay. Do not copy reference contact sheet labels or its gray backdrop.
ACTION: JUMP PAD LAUNCH. Eight ordered keyposes: (1) forward approach with rightward lean, arms ready; (2) deep compact knee/hip compression, both feet ready to push; (3) explosive leg extension with arms driving upward-forward; (4) immediate airborne launch, body elongated diagonally up-right, toes trailing; (5) rising flight with knees moderately tucked and arms balancing; (6) apex anticipation, torso upright, knees softly bent; (7) descending landing preparation, legs extend downward-forward, arms balance; (8) compact safe landing-recovery pose with bent knees, ready to run right. Character only, NO jump pad object. Distinct coherent successive poses; same actor in all 8 cells.

ACTION: ZIPLINE ATTACH, GLIDE AND RELEASE. Eight ordered keyposes: (1) airborne reaching upward with both arms to acquire an overhead handgrip; (2) both hands clasp an imaginary shared grip directly above the head, elbows slightly bent, legs tucked from momentum; (3) stable two-hand hanging glide, torso slightly backward, knees softly bent; (4) glide with legs trailing left and chest aimed right; (5) glide with a small pendulum leg extension forward-right; (6) preparing release, shoulders and elbows compress, knees draw up; (7) both hands let go together and arms open to balance, body travels right; (8) free airborne landing preparation, feet downward, knees soft. Suspended hand position and pelvis remain consistent across attached poses; handgrip, trolley, cable are NOT drawn. No standing poses while attached. Exactly eight character silhouettes.

ACTION: ROPE GRAPPLE SWING AND RELEASE. Eight ordered keyposes: (1) airborne with both hands reaching forward-up toward an imaginary rope grip; (2) both hands stacked above-front of head, elbows nearly extended as tension is acquired; (3) early backswing, arms extended diagonally up-right, torso leans back and bent legs trail left; (4) approaching lowest point, both hands overhead, body long under shoulders, knees softly bent; (5) powerful forward swing, both hands extend up-left, body arcs right and legs sweep forward; (6) forward/upward swing apex with hands up-left, torso angled right and knees tucked; (7) deliberate release at the forward arc, both hands open forward-up, body carries tangent up-right; (8) free flight with arms balancing, knees preparing for next landing. Side view, same pelvis root location per cell; orientation changes through body articulation. Hands grasp together when attached, no rope, no grappling gun, no hook, no anchor drawn. Exactly eight readable distinct poses.
